title: KP14 vyg25 with SIGN-SWITCHING types: the ladder mirrored, six types of equal share, loadings -0.14, -0.07, -0.02, 0.02, 0.07, 0.14, level-compensated, price 2.5
question: Does a type loading with zero cross-sectional mean raise the interaction share of the premium, and with it room and gap, over vyg25?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-26). In vyg25 the exposure is b_f x (growth-option share), a product of two POSITIVE factors, so most of the premium is additive in the two and a linear model in the ranks holds it: the interaction share of a product of independent positive factors is CV_b^2 CV_l^2 / ((1 + CV_b^2)(1 + CV_l^2) - 1), about 13% at vyg25's ladder (CV 0.64) and a share of CV 0.5. With E[b] = 0 the additive part in the share vanishes and the interaction share rises to CV_l^2 / (1 + CV_l^2), about 20%; the GS21 product (both factors mean zero) is the limit with no additive part at all. The mirrored ladder nests vyg25's magnitudes exactly; the negative types are firms the shock helps (an input or relative price). Level-compensated as vyg25 (bv_comp 1.2, type 0 = -0.14 the reference: type_theta 1, 1.40, 1.76, 2.09, 2.57, 3.36, because the Q-mean of y is -6 sd and e^{by} with b < 0 is worth more under Q).

FEASIBILITY (parameters_kp14 at these overrides, 2026-10-26, y_risk_neutral): the W-form discount const_base and the G stage's rho0 are type-independent and positive (rho0 min 0.0158); A0 finite for all six types (5.4 to 12.0 pre-compensation). The pre-fix vectors const_ty and rho_ty go negative for b < 0 (-0.24 / -0.46 at -0.14), which is what made K5's signed exposures infeasible in September under the old pricing; nothing on the live path reads them. Premium b.gamma from -0.35 to +0.35.

PREDICTION (2026-10-26): room rises above vyg25's 24% of the linear ceiling, to 30-40%; fair gap +0.015 to +0.03 (vyg25 +0.0148), 8+ of 10 seeds positive; the market's share stays near zero. FALSIFIED as 'a mean-zero loading raises the interaction share' if room is at or below 24%.
